# Prism Fabric

> Local prototype of a personal-data breach response desk: exposure triage, notification deadlines by jurisdiction, signed approvals, and a tamper-evident incident ledger. Fixtures are synthetic. Not legal advice.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): overview and local quick start
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): triage rules, scoring, ledger
- [API](docs/api.md): local preview API and the staging notice gateway
- [Runbook](docs/runbook.md): staging operations and key rotation
- [Deployment boundaries](docs/deployment.md): what is and is not included
- [Security and logging](SECURITY.md): what remote endpoints record

## Machine-readable
- [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml): staging notice gateway
- [fixtures/jurisdictions.json](fixtures/jurisdictions.json): illustrative notification rules
